race.description: Liam Howley Racing Family And Friends Mdn Plate
race.comment: PROFUMO (3) brings the strongest exposed form, having been beaten just under two lengths in Open Saturday company at Caulfield after a debut second in Open grade at Flemington. He resumes off a Flemington trial win and, with that level of form behind him, looks the one they have to beat. BORIDI (2) is the proven danger after closing last campaign with consecutive seconds, the latest a long-neck defeat as favourite at Ballarat Synthetic, and his Pakenham Synthetic trial win suggests he is ready to run well fresh. Race drops away thereafter. TARA'S CROWN (8) might be a chance resuming. Runs for a respected yard.
